content: Given an artist, band, or movie name, choose the one-character edit from the options that creates the funniest twist by clearly changing the meaning in a humorous way. Prioritize edits that introduce a new concept—like "fall out boy" becoming "fall out bot" (robot theme)—over edits that only adjust spelling or pronunciation without a meaningful shift. Avoid options that simply misspell or alter phonetics, such as "faqll out boy" or "fall outt boy," unless they also introduce a humorous new idea. Use this clear distinction to select the single best option.
